Seq2Graph-lite reliability-only tokenizer variant; catastrophic failure from the first visible eval onward (first collision=0.9997, best train collision=0.9284, generated collision=1519/3686, max_conflict=310). Diagnosis shows 17,960 direct-strong family edges were kept without the mask, over-smoothing dense same-brand neighborhoods.

Seq2Graph-lite reliability-plus-direct-weak-mask tokenizer variant; non-catastrophic candidate with best train collision=0.1243 and generated collision=12/3686 (max_conflict=3). R645 downstream SFT/evaluate later finished negative so carrier-only smoothness is not promotable.

Seq2Graph-lite（轻量 Seq2Graph） high-order carrier（高阶载体） placed inside mid-only pull-push（仅中层拉近推远）; generated collision（生成冲突） is 11/3686 with max_conflict=2 and train best collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.1142. Downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） is negative versus current v2_on_p05 and strongest original SFT, so this tokenizer（分词器） should not be promoted to RL（强化学习）.

Constraint restoration（约束恢复） variant: R650a high-order carrier + mid-only push-pull（高阶载体 + 仅中层推远拉近） with v2-style L1/L3/semantic constraints（第一层/第三层/语义约束） restored. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） finished non-catastrophic with generated collision（生成冲突） 12/3686, max_conflict=2, and train best collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.1324; downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） is still required before any conclusion.

Clean hierarchy（干净层级分工） branch with L1 high-confidence semantic pull（第一层高置信语义拉近）, L2 base pull-push（第二层基础拉近推远）, and stop-gradient prefix（前缀停梯度）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） collapsed: generated collision（生成冲突）=162/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=35, active L1（活跃第一层码）=19, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=375; do not promote（不要推进） to SFT（监督微调）.

Clean L2 interface（干净第二层接口） branch with L1 coarse smooth（第一层粗图平滑）, L2 local-multihop pull plus semantic-near weak push（第二层局部多跳拉近加语义近弱连接推远）, L3 local smooth（第三层局部平滑）, and stop-gradient prefix（前缀停梯度）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） finished non-catastrophic and downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） is stronger than R640c/R650a but still negative versus current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05）; not promotable（不可推进） to RL（强化学习）.

CoST-inspired（受 CoST 启发） pure L2 graph-guided InfoNCE（纯第二层图引导对比损失） branch. Uses fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） as mid graph（中图）, not local_multihop（局部多跳图）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） is non-catastrophic: best train collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.0887, generated collision（生成冲突）=11/3686, active L1（活跃第一层码）=118, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2527; worth downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） screening.

CoST-inspired（受 CoST 启发） hierarchical protected branch with L1/L3 pairwise pull（第一层/第三层成对拉近） and stop-gradient prefix（前缀停梯度）. Uses fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） as mid graph（中图）, not local_multihop（局部多跳图）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） was non-catastrophic but showed prefix compression（前缀压缩）: generated collision（生成冲突）=14/3686, active L1（活跃第一层码）=33, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=1989. Downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） finished negative: NDCG@10=0.0972 and HR@10=0.1361, below current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） and the strict recipe-aligned original baseline（严格配方对齐原版基线）. Evaluate（评测） reported root_branch_count（根分支数）=33 with constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0, so the issue looks more like code space compression（码本空间压缩） than invalid decoding（非法解码）.

Hierarchical collaboration-only（层级纯协同） branch: RQ-VAE（残差量化变分自编码器） preserves semantics（保留语义）, while L1 uses high-confidence coarse_purified collaborative pull（第一层高置信粗协同拉近）, L2 uses local_multihop graph-guided InfoNCE（第二层局部多跳图引导对比学习损失）, and L3 uses local_purified pull（第三层局部图拉近） with stop-gradient prefix（前缀停梯度）. Valid rerun after InfoNCE empty-row numerical fix（空行数值修复后有效重跑）: best train collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.1009, generated collision（生成冲突）=12/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, active L1（活跃第一层码）=90, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2274; downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） is required for verdict（裁决） Downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） finished negative versus current v2_on_p05 and R680a; not promotable to RL（强化学习）.

Semantic-collaborative intersection（语义-协同交集） branch: L1 uses high-confidence semantic-collab positives（第一层高置信语义-协同正边）, L2 uses semantic-conditioned local-multihop InfoNCE（第二层语义条件局部多跳对比学习损失）, and L3 uses weak local pull（第三层弱局部拉近） with stop-gradient prefix（前缀停梯度）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） finished non-catastrophic: best train collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.0849, generated collision（生成冲突）=14/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, active L1（活跃第一层码）=125, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2631. Structural proxy（结构代理指标） is weak versus original MiniOneRec baseline（原版基线） and R693a: target_l1_in_history（目标第一层出现在历史中）=0.3018, below original 0.4019 and R693a 0.3446; focus families（重点物品族） such as 3d_filament/tape/fastener are more fragmented（更碎片化）. Do not promote to SFT（监督微调） by default.

Strict v2 semantic-retention ablation（严格 v2 语义保持消融） keeping ambiguity-aware graph weighting（歧义感知图加权） and the original v2 graph roles（图角色） while setting semantic_coarse_weight=0 and semantic_mid_weight=0. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） finished non-catastrophic: best train collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.1454; generated collision（生成冲突）=11/3686; max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2; active L1（活跃第一层码）=123 versus v2 203; unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2234 versus v2 2680. Result suggests semantic retention（语义保持） is not required to avoid generated SID collision（生成 SID 冲突） but may help prevent prefix compression（前缀压缩）; downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） is needed for verdict（裁决）.

First collab-ranking（协同排序） mainline tokenizer（分词器） using fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） as the L2 carrier（第二层载体）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） was non-catastrophic but showed strong L2 compression（第二层压缩）: generated collision（生成冲突）=14/3686, active L1（活跃第一层码）=88, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=1558. Downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） finished clearly negative: NDCG@10=0.09235 and HR@10=0.13016, well below current v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） and the strict recipe-aligned original baseline（严格配方对齐原版基线）. Evaluate（评测） reported root_branch_count（根分支数）=88 with constraint_invalid_total（约束失配总数）=0, so the weakness is not invalid decoding（非法解码） but a structurally too-tight middle space（中层空间过紧）. This variant is now superseded by R720b local_multihop（R720b 局部多跳） inside the same method family（同一方法族）.

Clean R720a->R720b mid-graph replacement（中层图替换）: same collab-ranking（协同排序） loss, same stop-gradient（停梯度）, same L1/L3 roles（第一层/第三层角色）, but L2 positive graph（第二层正样本图） changes from fagsp_mid_base（基础中层图） to local_multihop（局部多跳图） and ranking negatives（排序负样本） are rebuilt accordingly. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） improved both structure and collision（结构与冲突） versus R720a: generated collision（生成冲突）=11/3686, active L1（活跃第一层码）=247, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2889. Downstream SFT/evaluate（监督微调/评测） also improved clearly over R720a, making this the current screening winner（筛选胜出版本） inside the collab-ranking family（协同排序方法族）. However it still does not beat v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05） or the strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调）, so it is not yet promotable to RL（强化学习）.

L1 carrier swap（第一层载体替换） test that keeps the successful R720b local_multihop（局部多跳） L2 setup but replaces coarse_purified（净化粗图） with prism_anchor_coarse（语义锚定粗图） for L1. This branch finished training normally but collapsed catastrophically at SID generation（SID 生成阶段灾难性塌缩）: generated collision（生成冲突）=1755/3686, best train collision（训练最佳冲突）=0.9748, final eval collision（最终评估冲突）=0.9767, active L1（活跃第一层码）=2, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=20, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=227. The collapse is dominated by one huge root code（超大根码） <a_146> that absorbs 3270 items, including many semantically unrelated products（语义无关物品）. Verdict（裁决）: current prism_anchor_coarse implementation is not a viable L1 carrier（不可行的第一层载体） for the collab-ranking family（协同排序方法族） and should not be pushed to SFT（监督微调）.

R720f K1=128 capacity-constrained（容量约束） tokenizer（分词器） based on R720e: same local_multihop（局部多跳） L2 ranking loss（第二层排序损失） and inverse-ambiguity（逆歧义） L1 pull（第一层拉近）, but num_emb_list changes to [128,256,256]. Tokenizer-side（分词器侧） L1 became healthier by compactness（紧凑性） proxies: active L1（活跃第一层码）=124, unique L12（唯一一二层前缀）=2640, generated collision（生成碰撞）=11/3686, L1<=10 small buckets（小桶）=2, target_l1_in_history（目标第一层出现在历史中）=0.2753. However downstream SFT（下游监督微调） is strongly negative versus R720e, so hard K1 reduction（硬性缩小第一层码本） is not viable in this form.

Semantic-L1 collaborative-deeper（语义第一层、协同下沉） tokenizer（分词器）: L1 has no graph/semantic auxiliary loss（无第一层图/语义辅助损失） and is driven by RQ reconstruction/quantization（残差量化重建/量化）, while L2 uses local_multihop ranking contrastive loss（局部多跳排序对比损失） and L3 uses weak local pull（弱局部拉近） with stop-gradient previous levels（前层停梯度）. Generated SID（生成 SID） is non-catastrophic: collision（碰撞）=14/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, active L1（活跃第一层码）=106, unique L12（唯一一二层前缀）=2547, H(L2|L1)=3.2003, H(L3|L12)=0.5632. Compared with R720e, focus families（重点物品族） become less fragmented（碎片化降低）: 3d_filament L1 count 16->13, tape 36->21, adhesive_epoxy 32->20. Candidate for SFT（监督微调） screening.

High-confidence L1 collaborative ranking（高置信第一层协同排序） tokenizer（分词器）: same L2/L3 design as semantic_l1_collab_deeper（同样第二层/第三层设计）, but L1 uses semantic-gated collaborative coarse graph（语义门控协同粗图） with inverse ambiguity weighting（逆歧义加权）. Generated SID（生成 SID） is not viable: collision（碰撞）=199/3686, generated collision rate（生成碰撞率）=5.40%, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=47, active L1（活跃第一层码）=25, unique L12（唯一一二层前缀）=425, H(L3|L12)=2.6924. Apparent family consolidation（家族聚合） is dominated by over-compression/full-SID conflicts（过度压缩/完整 SID 冲突）, so do not promote to SFT（监督微调）.

Minimal collaborative edit（最小协同编辑） tokenizer（分词器）: keep original RQ-VAE reconstruction/quantization（残差量化变分自编码器重建/量化） as the base, inject collaborative signal（协同信号） only through L3 local graph pull（第三层局部图拉近） with previous-level stop-gradient（前层停梯度）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） completed with generated collision（生成冲突）=13/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2. Downstream SFT/evaluate（下游监督微调/评测） under title_history2sid_on+desc_align_p05 reached NDCG@10=0.10159 and HR@10=0.14604: below strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调） and v2_on_p05（当前 v2_on_p05）, but stronger than R720e on NDCG@10 and supports the low-disturbance collaborative-injection（低扰动协同注入） direction.

Minimal collaborative edit（最小协同编辑） tokenizer（分词器）: keep original RQ-VAE reconstruction/quantization（残差量化变分自编码器重建/量化） as the base and inject collaborative signal（协同信号） only through L2 local_multihop ranking contrastive loss（第二层局部多跳排序对比损失） with previous-level stop-gradient（前层停梯度）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） completed with generated collision（生成冲突）=15/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, active L1（活跃第一层码）=88, and unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2449. Downstream SFT/evaluate（下游监督微调/评测） under title_history2sid_on+desc_align_p05 reached NDCG@10=0.10165 and HR@10=0.14736: slightly stronger than original_l3_collab_local（原版第三层局部协同） and R720e（R720e 协同排序） on @10, but still below strongest original SFT（原版最强监督微调） and v2_on_p05 SFT（当前 v2_on_p05 监督微调） on NDCG@10.

R730a original L3-only ambiguity-aware（仅第三层歧义感知） tokenizer（分词器）: same as original_l3_collab_local（原版第三层局部协同） except graph_scale_min/max（图缩放范围） changes from 1.0/1.0 to 0.5/1.5 so high-ambiguity items（高歧义物品） receive stronger L3 local graph smoothing（第三层局部图平滑）. Tokenizer generation（分词器生成） collapsed: generated collision（生成冲突）=657/3686, collision rate（冲突率）=0.17824, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=72, active L1（活跃第一层码）=18, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=256. Compared with original_l3_collab_local（原版第三层局部协同） at 13/3686 collision and active L1=95, ambiguity-aware L3 scaling is not viable in this form and should not be pushed to SFT（监督微调）.

R730b original L2-only ambiguity-aware（仅第二层歧义感知） tokenizer（分词器）: keep original RQ-VAE（原版残差量化变分自编码器） objective（目标） and add only L2 local_multihop smoothing（第二层局部多跳平滑） with graph_scale_min/max（图缩放范围） 0.5/1.5 and previous-level stop-gradient（前层停梯度）. Tokenizer generation（分词器生成） is non-catastrophic at 13/3686 collision（冲突）, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, but the prefix space（前缀空间） is strongly compressed: active L1（活跃第一层码）=50, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=1693, and top-5 L1 buckets（前 5 个第一层桶） cover 808 items（物品）. This is structurally safer than original_l3_ambiguity_aware（原版第三层歧义感知） but materially more concentrated than original_l2_multihop_ranking（原版第二层多跳排序） and original_l3_collab_local（原版第三层局部协同）, so it should stay a tokenizer-side control（分词器侧对照） rather than the next SFT（监督微调） priority.

R730c original L2 ranking ambiguity-aware（原版第二层排序歧义感知） tokenizer（分词器）: same push-pull interface（推拉接口） as original_l2_multihop_ranking（原版第二层多跳排序） but with graph_scale_min/max（图缩放范围） 0.5/1.5 so high-ambiguity items（高歧义物品） receive stronger ranking pressure（排序压力）. Tokenizer generation（分词器生成） is non-catastrophic at 15/3686 collision（冲突）, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, but train best collision（训练最佳冲突率） worsens to 0.1856 and the mid-level prefix space（中层前缀空间） becomes much more compressed than original_l2_multihop_ranking: active L1（活跃第一层码）=77, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=1649, and top-5 L1 buckets（前 5 个第一层桶） cover 743 items（物品）. The largest bucket（最大桶） is a heterogeneous mixed industrial bucket（异质工业混合桶） rather than a clean collaborative cluster（干净协同簇）, so this branch should remain tokenizer-side control（分词器侧对照） and not be prioritized for SFT（监督微调）.

R740a v2 L1 capacity cap（第一层容量限制） tokenizer（分词器）: original v2 ambiguity-aware graph supervision（歧义感知图监督） and semantic retention（语义保持） are unchanged, only num_emb_list（码本大小列表） changes from [256,256,256] to [128,256,256]. This is a clear tokenizer-side no-go（分词器侧停止）: train best collision（训练最佳冲突率）=0.59197, generated collision（生成冲突）=114/3686=0.03093, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=21, active L1（活跃第一层码） collapses to 15, and unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数） drops to 452. The cap does not produce a moderate L1 routeability repair（第一层可路由性修复）; it over-compresses the SID space（SID 空间） and should not be pushed to SFT（监督微调）.

QCR-L2 conflict-ranking（量化冲突感知第二层排序） tokenizer（分词器）: keep original RQ-VAE backbone（原版残差量化变分自编码器主干）, disable global graph propagation（全局图传播） and ordinary L2 ranking（普通第二层排序）, and activate L2 repulsion（第二层推开） only when semantic-near graph-weak negatives（语义近但图弱负样本） currently share the L2 prefix（第二层前缀）. Tokenizer/generate（分词器训练与生成） is healthy: generated collision（生成冲突）=11/3686, max_conflict（最大冲突簇）=2, active L1（活跃第一层码）=117, unique L2 pairs（唯一第二层前缀数）=2632. On the QCR negative-pair set（QCR 负样本对集合）, same-L2 rate（同第二层率）=0.01119, lower than original_l2_multihop_ranking（原版第二层多跳排序）的 0.01217 but not lower than v2/original_l3_collab_local（0.01025）. This is a good tokenizer-side SFT screening candidate（分词器侧监督微调筛选候选）, but not yet downstream-validated（下游验证）.
